subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'ROHINI' is written as '3' and 'BIHAR' is written as '3'. How will 'PRASHANT' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : Number of consonants in the given word depicts the code. So, • ROHINI' is written as '3'
